regression_risk: High — 11 field changes across 4 defect classes (legs, arms, recline, head). Sign conventions verified (hipAbduct + = adduction, shoulderFwd + = behind, spine - = back arch, globalTilt - = supine). Re-render verification REQUIRED to confirm (1) hands actually meet behind head (target L-R wrist dist <0.20, wrists z < head z), (2) legs spread wide (target knee x positions opposite signs), (3) elbow flexion produces forearms-come-back-to-head not forearms-go-up-further.
rationale: Description: SEATED FORWARD on chair edge (upright, not reclined) with back arched, hands clasped behind head, elbows wide, legs planted WIDE. Current config inverts multiple signs: (1) hipAbduct +25/+25 = ADDUCTION (cross) but description says WIDE = abduction (negative); (2) arms nearly vertical overhead (shoulder abducted 157-167°) instead of out-to-sides (~110°) with forearms bending back to clasp behind head; (3) globalTilt:-40 + spine:-32 + neck:-25 = 72° back recline but description says sit forward + slight head tilt. Fixes: flip hipAbduct to -20 (abduction = wide stance, sign verified + = adduction, - = abduction); reduce shoulder abduction -136/-124 → -100 (arms out to sides); increase elbow 79 → 110 (forearms come back to head); flip shoulderFwd -5 → +5 (positive = BEHIND per corrected convention, hands go behind head); reduce globalTilt -40 → -10 (sit upright on chair edge); reduce neck -25 → -10 (slight head back); reduce spine -32 → -25 (moderate arch, chest up).
